name: Start Transaction ( TransactionPayload )
purpose: Starts (or nests into) a database-style transaction: goes to the DBTransactions layout and, when no record is open, creates a new transaction record, resets its counter, stores the originating layout number, the script parameter payload and script name and commits it; then opens the transaction record (the lock that holds the changes) and increments the nesting counter. On an open error it returns to the original layout and returns the error.
writes:
DBTransactions (New Record/Request step 48, new record: only when no record is open)
DBTransactions::TransactionCounter#2 (Set Field step 50, new record: reset to 0)
DBTransactions::LayoutNumber#3 (Set Field step 51, new record)
DBTransactions::ScriptParameter#16 (Set Field step 57, new record)
DBTransactions::ScriptName#21 (Set Field step 58, new record)
DBTransactions::TransactionCounter#2 (Set Field step 76, current record: increment by 1)
open_question: Steps 23-27 (card window or off-screen window variants) are disabled; the transaction runs in the current window. $$Transaction.Store (step 49) and $$RunningOnServer (step 40) are session variables. The record-open lock is what makes related writes atomic until "End Transaction" commits or reverts, so the target needs an explicit transaction boundary. A copy of this module also exists in karbon_kontroller (script 28).

name: Save Transaction Result ( {result} )
purpose: Stores the transaction result: formats the script parameter as JSON if valid and writes it to DBTransactions::Result.
writes: DBTransactions::Result#17 (Set Field step 8, current record (open transaction record))
open_question: Does not commit; the record stays open for End Transaction. A copy of this module also exists in karbon_kontroller (script 29).

name: Save Transaction Result After Commit ( {result} )
purpose: Saves a transaction result only when the stored DBTransactions::Result is not already an error (via "Save Transaction Result"), commits, and returns the stored result. Effect owner if kept: server-domain (transaction result save).
writes: DBTransactions::Result#17 (via Perform Script step 5 -> script 365 Set Field step 8, current record: open transaction record, only if the stored Result is not an error)
open_question: Commits the transaction record at step 6 whenever the stored Result is not an error, which releases the open-record lock before End Transaction runs; the intent (commit-then-save) is unclear. No caller found, so it is vendored module code no live script in this share calls.

name: End Transaction ( {error}  )
purpose: Ends a transaction: decrements the nesting counter and, for a nested transaction (counter still above 0), stores the error or an "exiting nested transaction" result and returns; at the outermost level it tries to commit the transaction record (with error capture on), hands any commit error to "Transaction Handle Error", reverts and force-commits the error as Result if there was an error, restores the original layout and returns the stored result.
writes:
DBTransactions::TransactionCounter#2 (Set Field step 38, current record (open transaction record))
DBTransactions::Result#17 (Set Field step 41, current record (open transaction record))
DBTransactions::Result#17 (Set Field step 43, current record (open transaction record))
DBTransactions::Result#17 (Set Field step 87, current record (open transaction record))
calls:
karbon_Build.fmp12/scripts/368 "Transaction Handle Error" (step 27)
karbon_Build.fmp12/scripts/368 "Transaction Handle Error" (step 74)
open_question: Step 92 goes to the layout number saved at start (LayoutNumberByCalc). Close Window steps 94-95 are disabled. The "revert on error" (step 86) discards every uncommitted change made through the open transaction record and its related records; the target needs rollback semantics. A copy of this module also exists in karbon_kontroller (script 31).

name: Transaction Handle Error
purpose: Error-hook stub for the transactions module: returns its script parameter unchanged (the call to a custom error handler is disabled and points to an unknown script).
open_question: Step 1 (Perform Script to an unknown script, id 0) is disabled; clients are meant to replace this with their own error handler.

name: Delete First Portal Row (portalLayoutObjectName)
purpose: Generic helper: goes to the portal object named by the script parameter, selects its first row and deletes that portal row without a dialog, returns to the portal and returns the error. Effect owner if kept: server-domain (delete of one related record).
writes: delete: related record shown in the portal named by $portalLayoutObjectName (Delete Portal Row step 59, portal row: first row)
open_question: Dynamic: the portal is chosen by name at run time, so the deleted table is not known from this script. No caller found in karbon_Build, so it is vendored module code that no live script in this share calls.

name: Open Transaction Record Again
purpose: Goes to the DBTransactions layout and opens the transaction record again.
open_question: No caller found; vendored module helper (re-open after a commit).

name: Commit Re-Opened Transaction Record ( result )
purpose: Writes the script parameter to DBTransactions::Result if non-empty, commits the record, goes to the layout number saved in DBTransactions::LayoutNumber and returns the result. Effect owner if kept: server-domain (transaction result save).
writes: DBTransactions::Result#17 (Set Field step 4, current record (open transaction record))
open_question: No caller found; vendored module helper used with "Open Transaction Record Again".
